name: app-6a1dbc406e948191b72887837deec949
description: BCA Research brings BCA's research into ChatGPT. Signed-in users can search BCA reports, read excerpts and get synthesized answers with citations, find BCA charts, open BCA dashboards, and find the moments in BCA webcasts where a topic was discussed. Results are limited to the BCA content the signed-in user's account can access.

interface.longDescription:
BCA Research is an independent provider of global investment research, covering macroeconomics, asset allocation, equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and geopolitics.

This app lets BCA Research clients use BCA's research inside ChatGPT. Sign in with your BCA Research account, then ask in plain language:

- Search BCA reports by topic, publication, author or date, and open the original report on bcaresearch.com.
- Ask an analytical question (for example, BCA's view on US equities or the Fed) and get an answer drawn from BCA's reports, with every claim cited to the report it came from.
- Read excerpts and metadata from a specific report.
- Find BCA charts on a topic or for a data series, shown as chart cards.
- Open BCA dashboards.
- Find the clip in a BCA webcast or BCA Live meeting where a topic was discussed, and play it.

The app only reads content: it never changes anything in your account. Results are limited to the BCA content your account can access; when part of BCA's content was not searched for that reason, the answer says so.

Requires a BCA Research account.
defaultPrompt: Find recent BCA reports about Fed rate cuts
What is BCA's current view on US equities versus bonds?
Show me BCA charts on US core inflation

positive.description: Report search: the user asks for recent reports from a named BCA research platform on a topic.
positive.prompt: Find recent CoreMacro reports about Fed rate cuts.
positive.expected_behavior: The app searches BCA reports filtered to the CoreMacro platform and a recent date window, and lists matching reports with date, title (linked to bcaresearch.com) and authors. It states the date window it searched and does not claim to have read the full text of every report.

positive.description: Analytical question: the user asks for BCA's view on a market question and expects a synthesized, cited answer.
positive.prompt: What is BCA's current view on US equities versus government bonds over the next 12 months?
positive.expected_behavior: The app answers from BCA's own reports, cites each claim inline with numbered references, ends with a Sources list linking to the reports used, and closes with a note that the summary is AI-generated and should be checked against the sources.

positive.description: Chart search: the user asks for BCA charts on an economic topic.
positive.prompt: Show me BCA charts on US core inflation.
positive.expected_behavior: The app returns BCA charts about US core inflation, shown as chart cards with the chart image, title and the report each chart appeared in. It does not invent chart data or describe charts it did not return.

positive.description: Webcast clip search: the user asks where a topic was discussed in BCA's webcasts.
positive.prompt: Find a BCA webcast clip where the strategists discussed China's property market.
positive.expected_behavior: The app returns one or more webcast clips about China's property market, shown in the clip widget with the speaker, the webcast title and date, and a playable clip starting at the relevant moment, with a Clips list citing each clip used.

positive.description: Single report: the user names a report and asks what it says.
positive.prompt: Summarize the key points of BCA's most recent Chief Economist's View report.
positive.expected_behavior: The app finds the most recent Chief Economist's View report, retrieves its excerpts, and summarizes its main arguments with citations to that report and a link to it on bcaresearch.com.

negative.description: Live market data is out of scope: BCA Research does not provide real-time quotes, so the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is Apple's stock price right now?

negative.description: Another firm's research is out of scope: the app only covers BCA Research content and must not present BCA content as another firm's view.
negative.prompt: What does Goldman Sachs expect the Fed to do at its next meeting?

negative.description: General coding help is unrelated to BCA research, so the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that calculates a 200-day moving average.

publication.release_notes: First release of BCA Research for ChatGPT: search BCA reports, get cited answers from BCA research, find BCA charts and dashboards, and find clips from BCA webcasts, all limited to the BCA content the user's account can access.
